title: A novel 1,2,4-triazole derivative inhibits epithelial-mesenchymal transition in metastatic colorectal cancer via beta-catenin suppression.
authors: Abdelmegeed, Heba; Abo-Salem, Heba; Abd El Salam, Hayam A; El-Sawy, Eslam R
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估三唑衍生物抑制结直肠癌EMT及β-catenin的活性，仅含分子对接辅助验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: 1,2,4-Triazole derivatives have emerged as a significant class of compounds with diverse biological activities, notably their anticancer properties. This therapeutic utility lies in their molecular flexibility and their capacity to interact with key enzymes implicated in oncogenesis. However, their role in inhibiting tumor cell metastasis is not fully investigated. Hence, we assessed the ability of a series of 5-heptadecyl-4H-1,2,4-triazole incorporated N-substituted indoles, which we previously developed, to suppress the migration of metastatic colorectal cancer. To achieve that, we analyzed the mechanism underlying the antitumor effect of compound 10d, which demonstrated the highest antitumor activity among the synthesized 1,2,4-triazole/indole hybrids. Furthermore, we investigated the potential of compound 10d to inhibit epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in colorectal cancer cells. Our findings showed that compound 10d exerts its antitumor action by inducing both apoptosis and cell cycle arrest at S-phase. Moreover, 10d inhibited the migration and invasion of colorectal cancer cells in vitro, in addition to EMT inhibition. This inhibition was attributed to its capacity to suppress the transcription of beta-catenin and vimentin, which are key markers of EMT. Additionally, 10d significantly inhibited beta-catenin at the protein level. Collectively, our findings highlight the promising potential of 10d as a novel therapeutic agent for reducing cell migration and invasion, thereby inhibiting colorectal cancer metastasis. Molecular docking study supported the results for compound 10d. Where 10d showed strong binding affinity to a human beta-catenin complex (PDB ID: 2GL7) (-6.5 kcal/mol) via hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions, along with specific drug-likeness properties, including favorable oral absorption, moderate solubility, and a safer toxicity profile, despite some metabolic limitations.
abstract_zh: 1,2,4-三唑衍生物已成为一类具有多种生物活性的重要化合物，尤其是其抗癌特性。这种治疗效用源于其分子灵活性及其与肿瘤发生中关键酶相互作用的能力。然而，它们在抑制肿瘤细胞转移中的作用尚未得到充分研究。因此，我们评估了我们先前开发的一系列含5-十七烷基-4H-1,2,4-三唑的N-取代吲哚化合物抑制转移性结直肠癌迁移的能力。为实现这一目标，我们分析了化合物10d的抗肿瘤作用机制，该化合物在合成的1,2,4-三唑/吲哚杂合体中表现出最高的抗肿瘤活性。此外，我们研究了化合物10d抑制结直肠癌细胞上皮-间质转化 (epithelial-mesenchymal transition, EMT) 的潜力。我们的研究结果表明，化合物10d通过诱导细胞凋亡和S期细胞周期阻滞发挥其抗肿瘤作用。此外，10d在体外抑制了结直肠癌细胞的迁移和侵袭，并抑制了EMT。这种抑制归因于其抑制β-连环蛋白和波形蛋白转录的能力，这些是EMT的关键标志物。另外，10d在蛋白质水平上显著抑制了β-连环蛋白。总体而言，我们的研究结果凸显了10d作为减少细胞迁移和侵袭、从而抑制结直肠癌转移的新型治疗剂的巨大潜力。分子对接研究支持了化合物10d的结果，其中10d通过氢键和疏水相互作用与人β-连环蛋白复合物 (PDB ID: 2GL7) 表现出强结合亲和力 (-6.5 kcal/mol)，并具有特定的药物相似性特性，包括良好的口服吸收、中等溶解度和更安全的毒性特征，尽管存在一些代谢局限性。
